description: Copy of the barakahlabs/configs presets (default, mobile, base, tauri) plus this repo's rules at the end
This repo is public, and the Renovate app can't read private presets from public repos, so keep it in sync by hand
Use only even Node majors (the LTS lines), so the rule needs no yearly edit
An even major is offered from its April release, before it becomes LTS in October

packageRules.description: Android in one PR: AndroidX, Material, Kotlin, the Android Gradle plugin and Gradle itself
Toolchain pinned in mise.toml (Node, pnpm, Java, ...) in one PR
Wait 30 days before updating GitHub Actions to avoid potential (security) issues with new releases
Prevent relying on packages that can be removed from the registry up to 3 days after publication
Same wait for crates.io, where authors can yank a release
Tauri crates and npm packages must move together, so one PR for all of them, majors included. Merge by hand after building every platform
Only non-major updates automerge; majors wait for a review. Keep this rule last so it overrides the groups above
NDK_HOME in mise.toml has the android-sdk version in its path, so update it by hand

description: Renovate writes Corretto versions as 25.0.5+8.0.LTS, which mise can't install (it names them corretto-25.0.5.0.10), so update java by hand
matchDepNames, not matchPackageNames: Renovate looks java up as the package java-jdk, and matchPackageNames compares that

packageRules.description: turso is pinned (ADR 0001) and search relies on its behaviour, so updates wait for approval on the dependency dashboard
